domains.label: Economy
domains.description: Growth, prices, labor markets and income.

domains.label: People
domains.description: Population, health, education and youth labor outcomes.

inflation_cpi.label: Inflation, consumer prices
inflation_cpi.description: Annual percentage change in consumer prices.

gdp_growth.label: GDP growth
gdp_growth.description: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices.

unemployment.label: Unemployment
unemployment.description: Share of the total labor force without work but available for and seeking employment.

gdp_per_capita.label: GDP per capita
gdp_per_capita.description: GDP divided by midyear population, in current U.S. dollars.

life_expectancy.label: Life expectancy at birth
life_expectancy.description: Average number of years a newborn is expected to live.

youth_unemployment.label: Youth unemployment
youth_unemployment.description: Unemployment among ages 15–24 as a share of the youth labor force.

secondary_enrollment.label: Secondary school enrollment
secondary_enrollment.description: Gross enrollment ratio for secondary education.

gini.label: Gini index
gini.description: Measure of income or consumption inequality; higher values indicate greater inequality.

poverty_national.label: Poverty headcount at national poverty lines
poverty_national.description: Share of the population living below the national poverty line.

renewable_energy.label: Renewable energy consumption
renewable_energy.description: Renewable energy as a share of total final energy consumption.

forest_area.label: Forest area
forest_area.description: Forest area as a share of land area.

electricity_access.label: Access to electricity
electricity_access.description: Share of population with access to electricity.

drinking_water_basic.label: At least basic drinking water services
drinking_water_basic.description: Share of population using at least basic drinking water services.

sanitation_basic.label: At least basic sanitation services
sanitation_basic.description: Share of population using at least basic sanitation services.

internet_users.label: Individuals using the Internet
internet_users.description: Share of population using the Internet.
